Name: Zerah of Bozrah
Summary: Zerah of Bozrah was the father of Jobab, who reigned as king in Edom.
KeyStory: Zerah is named only as Jobab's father, in the list of Edom's kings — a different Zerah from Judah's and Reuel's sons.
LifeLesson: Three men named Zerah appear in Genesis, and God knows each one apart.
